note: BLM campground in a multicolored badlands canyon of the Rainbow Basin Natural Area, 8 miles north of Barstow off Irwin Road (not Fort Irwin Road) by Fossil Bed Road. The single water tap is refilled weekly by truck, so bring drinking water; holding tanks can be emptied in Barstow. Off-highway vehicle staging is not allowed, and the washes carry a flash-flood risk. --Claude
summary: Owl Canyon (BLM Barstow): $6/night written (none stored); 22 FCFS sites, vault toilets, trucked-in water tap, no dump confirmed; rec.gov 15172 is information-only. Pin is on the loops (BLM's own coordinate is ~2 km off). No access warning for the campground road.
flags: FEES: $6 per night via self-serve drop box (BLM page) - new; no rate was stored.

ACCESS: the only high-clearance/4WD wording is for the one-way Fossil Canyon Loop Road ('best driven with a high clearance or four-wheel drive vehicles'), a touring route, not the campground road; the BLM says nothing about the campground access road. The old note's 'few miles of maintained washboard gravel road' and 'Level pads fit small-to-mid RVs' are on no agency page and are dropped. No posted rig limit.
OHV: BLM forbids OHV staging at the campground - general campground, no flag.
PIN: stored 35.0226,-117.0211 is on the campground loops (imagery); BLM's 'Geographic Coordinates 35.01236944, -117.0385861' (also on rec.gov) sit ~2 km WSW. No move.
